tasks.prompt: DEVELOPMENT SET (agent-written harness shakedown material, never the holdout). cells.csv lists calorimeter cells on a 1 cm square grid (x_cm, y_cm) with their deposited energy in GeV. Cluster them: keep cells above 0.1 GeV, and join kept cells that touch along an edge or corner (|dx| <= 1 cm and |dy| <= 1 cm) into one cluster. The cluster energy is the sum of its cells' deposited energies. Write the clusters to clusters.csv and report the number of clusters and the energy of the most energetic cluster.

report_fields.subject: max_cluster_energy
report_fields.description: the energy of the most energetic cluster, with its unit

report_fields.subject: intercept
